question_text: What is 'Write Amplification' in database storage engines?

options.text: The ratio of total bytes written to non-volatile storage versus the logical payload bytes requested by the application
The increase in network bandwidth during replication
The number of concurrent insert queries
The size of the database connection pool

answer_explanation: Due to writing to WAL, dirty page flushing in B-trees, or repeated multi-tier compaction in LSM-trees, writing 100 bytes of user data can cause 1,000+ bytes written to underlying storage disks.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Due to writing to WAL, dirty page flushing in B-trees, or repeated multi-tier compaction in LSM-trees, writing 100 bytes of user data can cause 1,000+ bytes written to underlying storage disks.
